component.name: Sonicake Manager
component.summary: Manage Sonicake guitar processors on Linux

description.p: Sonicake Manager for Linux is an open-source desktop manager for Sonicake guitar processors. It talks to the hardware over USB-MIDI using a documented implementation of the device's published SysEx payload format.

Features include browsing and selecting the 100 preset slots, editing the current preset (module on/off, effect selection, parameters, chain order, preset volume, amp mode), saving the edit buffer to user slots, exporting and re-importing the current preset as JSON, whole-bank backup export, user IR/clone slot name listing, and editing supported global settings.
This project is independent and is not affiliated with Sonicake.
Initial release: current-preset editor, preset browser, global settings, JSON export/import, whole-bank backup export, IR/clone slot listing, CLI.
